newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes higher on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes higher on short-covering.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed higher on short-covering as rains in U.S. rice harvesting areas also provided light support, traders said.
"It was mainly short-covering of the oversold values," a trader said. "The rain in the rice areas was somewhat supportive."
Rice closed six to 12 cents per cwt higher, with September up six at $10.13 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 300 contracts, down from 521 Friday, according to the CBOT.
Rice options volume was estimated at 20 contracts, up from six Friday.
